source.text: נַחֲמ֥וּ נַחֲמ֖וּ עַמִּ֑י יֹאמַ֖ר אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.

en.L: Comfort, comfort my people, \q says your God.
en.B: Bring comfort, bring comfort to my people, \q says your God.
en.R: Your God says this: \q Comfort my people. Yes, comfort them.

es.L: {{plural_you:Consuelen, consuelen|Consolad, consolad}} a mi pueblo, \q dice {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Den consuelo, den|Dad consuelo, dad}} consuelo a mi pueblo, \q dice {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Su Dios|Vuestro Dios}} dice esto: \q {{plural_you:Consuelen|Consolad}} a mi pueblo. Sí, {{plural_you:consuélenlo|consoladlo}}.

fr.L: Consolez, consolez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q dit votre Dieu.
fr.B: Réconfortez, réconfortez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q dit votre Dieu.
fr.R: Votre Dieu dit ceci : \q Consolez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. Oui, réconfortez-le.

sw.L: Wafarijini, wafarijini watu wangu, \q anasema Mungu wenu.
sw.B: Wapeni faraja, wapeni faraja watu wangu, \q anasema Mungu wenu.
sw.R: Mungu wenu anasema hivi: \q Wafarijini watu wangu. Naam, wafarijini.

vi.L: Hãy an ủi, hãy an ủi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi phán.
vi.B: Hãy đem niềm an ủi, hãy đem niềm an ủi đến cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi phán.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi phán thế này: \q Hãy an ủi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Phải, hãy an ủi họ.

decisions.choice: a new part of the book begins: words of comfort for God's people after the fall of Jerusalem and the exile in Babylon
decisions.reason: From here on the book speaks to people for whom Jerusalem lies in ruins (44:26; 51:3; 52:9) and who live in Babylon (43:14; 47:1; 48:20), and it names Cyrus of Persia, who let the exiles return in 539 BC (44:28; 45:1; Ezra 1:1-4). Chapters 1-39 mostly address Judah in the time of the Assyrian threat. The decision states the setting the chapters speak to; it does not decide when or by whom they were written.

decisions.choice: comfort, comfort: a doubled command given to more than one hearer
decisions.reason: The verb is plural, so God tells a group to comfort his people; the text does not say who they are (prophets, or the heavenly council of 6:8). Doubling a command adds urgency (51:9, 17; 52:1).

decisions.choice: my people ... your God: the words of the covenant
decisions.reason: "I will be your God and you will be my people" is the covenant promise (Leviticus 26:12; Jeremiah 7:23). After the judgment of chapters 1-39 and the exile, God still calls them "my people" (compare Hosea 1:9; 2:23). The verb "says" is in a form that can mean "keeps saying".

decisions.choice: Bring comfort, bring comfort
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the doubled command with a fuller verb phrase; Literal keeps the bare repetition.

decisions.choice: Consuelen, consuelen ... su Dios (plural_you)
decisions.reason: The commands and "your God" are plural in the Hebrew, spoken to an unnamed group, so they take plural_you; "su Dios" is spanned whole so that "su" is not misread as "his".

decisions.choice: "Wafarijini, wafarijini" (L); "Wapeni faraja" (B); "anasema Mungu wenu"
decisions.reason: The doubled command is plural, as in the Hebrew, and takes the object marker "wa-" for "my people"; the wording was drafted from the Hebrew and kept apart from the familiar Swahili form of this verse, as the terms note asks for Isaiah 40.

decisions.choice: "Consolez" (L), "Réconfortez" (B) for the doubled command, plural "vous"
decisions.reason: The command is plural in the Hebrew, addressed to unnamed messengers (m2); Balanced uses a fuller verb, as the English "Bring comfort".

decisions.choice: "an ủi", and "các ngươi" for the plural hearers
decisions.reason: The command is plural, given to hearers the text does not name; God speaks to them as a group, "các ngươi". "An ủi" is the plain modern verb, chosen over the older "yên ủi" to keep the line in present-day Vietnamese.

source.text: דַּבְּר֞וּ עַל־לֵ֤ב יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וְקִרְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֤י מָֽלְאָה֙ צְבָאָ֔הּ כִּ֥י נִרְצָ֖ה עֲוֺנָ֑הּ כִּ֤י לָקְחָה֙ מִיַּ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה כִּפְלַ֖יִם בְּכָל־חַטֹּאתֶֽיהָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Speak to [the] heart of Jerusalem and call to her that is completed her service, that is accepted her iniquity, that she has received from [the] hand of Yahweh double for all her sins.

en.L: Speak to [the] heart of Jerusalem, and call out to her \q that her service is completed, \q that her iniquity is paid off, \q that she has received from the hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} double for all her sins.
en.B: Speak to the heart of Jerusalem and call out to her \q that her time of forced labor is finished, \q that the penalty for her guilt has been paid, \q that she has received from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s hand double for all her sins.
en.R: Speak kindly to the people of Jerusalem. \q Call out to them that their time of suffering is over. \q The price for their sin has been paid. \q They have received from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} double punishment for all their sins.

es.L: {{plural_you:Hablen|Hablad}} al corazón de Jerusalén, y {{plural_you:proclámenle|proclamadle}} \q que su servicio se ha cumplido, \q que su iniquidad está pagada, \q que ha recibido de la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} el doble por todos sus pecados.
es.B: {{plural_you:Hablen|Hablad}} al corazón de Jerusalén y {{plural_you:anúncienle|anunciadle}} \q que su tiempo de trabajos forzados ha terminado, \q que la pena por su culpa ya está pagada, \q que ha recibido de la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} el doble por todos sus pecados.
es.R: {{plural_you:Hablen|Hablad}} con cariño a la gente de Jerusalén. \q {{plural_you:Anúncienles|Anunciadles}} que su tiempo de sufrimiento ha terminado. \q El precio de su pecado ya está pagado. \q Han recibido {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} doble castigo por todos sus pecados.

fr.L: Parlez au cœur de Jérusalem et criez-lui \q que son service est accompli, \q que son iniquité est payée, \q qu’elle a reçu de la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} le double pour tous ses péchés.
fr.B: Parlez au cœur de Jérusalem et annoncez-lui à grands cris \q que son temps de corvée est terminé, \q que la peine de sa faute est acquittée, \q qu’elle a reçu de la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} le double pour tous ses péchés.
fr.R: Parlez avec douceur aux habitants de Jérusalem. \q Criez-leur que leur temps de souffrance est fini. \q Le prix de leur péché a été payé. \q Ils ont reçu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} une double punition pour tous leurs péchés.

sw.L: Semeni na moyo wa Yerusalemu, na kumwita \q kwamba utumishi wake umekamilika, \q kwamba uovu wake umelipiwa, \q kwamba amepokea kutoka mkononi mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mara mbili kwa ajili ya dhambi zake zote.
sw.B: Semeni na Yerusalemu kwa maneno yanayoutuliza moyo wake, mkamtangazie \q kwamba muda wake wa kazi ya kulazimishwa umekwisha, \q kwamba adhabu ya hatia yake imelipwa, \q kwamba amepokea kutoka mkononi mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mara mbili kwa ajili ya dhambi zake zote.
sw.R: Semeni kwa upole na watu wa Yerusalemu. \q Watangazieni kwamba wakati wao wa mateso umekwisha. \q Gharama ya dhambi zao imelipwa. \q Wamepokea kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} adhabu mara mbili kwa ajili ya dhambi zao zote.

vi.L: Hãy nói vào lòng Giê-ru-sa-lem, và kêu gọi nó \q rằng thời kỳ khổ dịch của nó đã mãn, \q rằng tội ác của nó đã được trả xong, \q rằng nó đã nhận từ tay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gấp đôi vì mọi tội lỗi của nó.
vi.B: Hãy nói lời êm dịu với Giê-ru-sa-lem và loan báo cho nó \q rằng thời lao dịch khổ sai của nó đã chấm dứt, \q rằng hình phạt cho tội lỗi nó đã được trả xong, \q rằng nó đã nhận từ tay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gấp đôi vì mọi tội lỗi của mình.
vi.R: Hãy nói những lời dịu dàng với dân Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Hãy báo cho họ biết thời kỳ đau khổ của họ đã qua. \q Giá phải trả cho tội lỗi của họ đã được trả xong. \q Họ đã nhận từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hình phạt gấp đôi vì mọi tội lỗi của mình.

decisions.choice: speak to the heart: speak kindly, to win someone over and reassure them
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of comforting and persuading someone who is hurt or afraid (Genesis 34:3; 50:21; Ruth 2:13; Hosea 2:16).

decisions.choice: her service: a hard term of forced service, like a soldier's or a laborer's; her iniquity is paid off: the penalty for her guilt has been accepted as fully paid
decisions.reason: The word for service is used of military service and of hard labor (Job 7:1; 14:14). The verb for her iniquity is used in Leviticus 26:41, 43 of a people who "pay off" their guilt in exile.

decisions.choice: double: a full, ample punishment, more than enough to answer for her sins
alternatives: double blessing in place of punishment (61:7)
decisions.reason: Jerusalem has suffered enough; the word stresses that the punishment is complete (compare Jeremiah 16:18). Some take "double" to mean an exact matching equivalent, like a document folded in two; the point is the same: nothing more is owed.

decisions.choice: the people of Jerusalem ... them; double punishment
decisions.reason: Readable says that the city stands for its people and supplies "punishment", which the context implies; Literal and Balanced keep the city as "her" and the bare "double".

decisions.choice: "nói vào lòng"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "speak to the heart", which the meaning decision explains as speaking kindly to reassure; Balanced and Readable say "nói lời êm dịu".

source.text: ק֣וֹל קוֹרֵ֔א בַּמִּדְבָּ֕ר פַּנּ֖וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה יַשְּׁרוּ֙ בָּעֲרָבָ֔ה מְסִלָּ֖ה לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A voice calling: in the wilderness clear [the] way of Yahweh; make straight in the desert plain a highway for our God.

en.L: A voice is calling: \q In the wilderness clear the way of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q make level in the desert plain a highway for our God.
en.B: A voice calls out: \q In the wilderness clear a road for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q across the desert plain lay a straight highway for our God.
en.R: Someone is calling out: \q Clear a road through the wilderness for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Build a straight highway across the desert for our God.

es.L: Una voz clama: \q En el desierto {{plural_you:preparen|preparad}} el camino {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; \q {{plural_you:allanen|allanad}} en la estepa una calzada para nuestro Dios.
es.B: Una voz grita: \q En el desierto {{plural_you:preparen|preparad}} un camino para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q {{plural_you:tracen|trazad}} en la estepa una calzada recta para nuestro Dios.
es.R: Alguien está gritando: \q {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} un camino en el desierto para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q {{plural_you:Construyan|Construid}} una calzada recta a través del desierto para nuestro Dios.

fr.L: Une voix crie : \q Dans le désert, préparez le chemin {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; \q aplanissez dans la steppe une route pour notre Dieu.
fr.B: Une voix proclame : \q Dans le désert, préparez le chemin {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; \q à travers la steppe, tracez une route droite pour notre Dieu.
fr.R: Quelqu’un crie : \q Préparez un chemin à travers le désert pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Construisez une route droite à travers le désert pour notre Dieu.

sw.L: Sauti inaita: \q Nyikani itengenezeni njia ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q nyoosheni jangwani njia kuu kwa ajili ya Mungu wetu.
sw.B: Sauti inaita: \q Nyikani msafishieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} njia; \q katika uwanda wa jangwa tengenezeni njia kuu iliyonyooka kwa ajili ya Mungu wetu.
sw.R: Mtu fulani anapaza sauti: \q Safisheni njia nyikani kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Jengeni njia kuu iliyonyooka jangwani kwa ajili ya Mungu wetu.

vi.L: Có tiếng đang kêu: \q Trong hoang mạc hãy dọn đường cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q trong đồng bằng sa mạc hãy san phẳng một đường cái cho Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.B: Có tiếng kêu lên: \q Hãy mở một con đường cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong hoang mạc; \q hãy làm một đường cái thẳng tắp băng qua đồng bằng sa mạc cho Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.R: Có người đang kêu lớn: \q Hãy dọn một con đường xuyên qua hoang mạc cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Hãy xây một đường cái thẳng băng qua sa mạc cho Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.

decisions.choice: "in the wilderness" goes with "clear the way", not with "a voice calling"
alternatives: a voice of one calling in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the LORD
decisions.reason: The Hebrew accents divide the line after "calling", and "in the wilderness" matches "in the desert plain" in the next line: the road is to be built in the desert. The Septuagint can be read "a voice of one calling in the wilderness", and Matthew 3:3, Mark 1:3, Luke 3:4 and John 1:23 quote it that way, applying the words to John the Baptizer, who preached in the wilderness. Both readings point to the coming of the LORD.

decisions.choice: a highway for God: a road on which the LORD himself returns, leading his people home through the desert
decisions.reason: The picture recalls God leading Israel through the wilderness at the exodus (Exodus 13:21; Psalm 68:8) and anticipates the road home from Babylon (35:8-10; 43:19; 48:20-21; 62:10). Royal processions had roads prepared before them.

decisions.choice: clear: remove what blocks the way
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn things aside or clear them away, as in 57:14 and 62:10 ("clear the stones").

decisions.choice: Someone is calling out
decisions.reason: Readable says "someone" for "a voice"; the speaker is not named.

decisions.choice: preparen el camino
decisions.reason: The verb means to clear a road; Spanish says "preparen el camino", the key words of Matthew 3:3 as published, so the reader can see the quotation, without copying the Greek-based wording of the Gospel.

decisions.choice: "nyikani", "njia ya BWANA"
decisions.reason: The verse is quoted in Matthew 3:3, whose published Swahili has "nyikani" and "njia ya Bwana"; those key words are kept, while "nyikani" goes with the command, as the Hebrew punctuation and the meaning decision ask (Matthew, from the Greek, joins it to the voice).

decisions.choice: "préparez le chemin du SEIGNEUR"
decisions.reason: Matthew 3:3 quotes the verse ("Préparez le chemin du Seigneur"); French keeps the key words so the quotation can be seen. "Dans le désert" goes with the command, as the meaning decision says (m1).

decisions.choice: "Trong hoang mạc" begins the command
alternatives: "Có tiếng kêu trong hoang mạc", as Matthew 3:3 and Luke 3:4
decisions.reason: The Hebrew accents put "in the wilderness" with "clear the way", as the meaning decision says; the Gospels quote the Greek, which joins it to the voice. "Dọn đường" is kept so the quotation can be recognised.

source.text: כָּל־גֶּיא֙ יִנָּשֵׂ֔א וְכָל־הַ֥ר וְגִבְעָ֖ה יִשְׁפָּ֑לוּ וְהָיָ֤ה הֶֽעָקֹב֙ לְמִישׁ֔וֹר וְהָרְכָסִ֖ים לְבִקְעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Every valley will be lifted up, and every mountain and hill will become low, and will become the steep [ground] level ground, and the rough places a plain.

en.L: Every valley will be lifted up, \q and every mountain and hill will be made low, \q and the uneven [ground] will become level ground, \q and the rugged places a broad plain.
en.B: Every valley will rise \q and every mountain and hill will sink; \q the broken ground will be made flat, \q and the rugged heights an open plain.
en.R: Every valley will be raised. \q Every mountain and hill will be made lower. \q Rough, hilly ground will be made flat. \q Steep ridges will become wide, level land.

es.L: Todo valle será alzado, \q y todo monte y colina será rebajado, \q y lo escabroso se volverá llano, \q y los lugares ásperos, llanura.
es.B: Todo valle se levantará \q y todo monte y colina se hundirá; \q el terreno quebrado quedará llano, \q y las alturas escarpadas, una llanura abierta.
es.R: Todo valle será rellenado. \q Todo monte y colina será rebajado. \q El terreno lleno de colinas será aplanado. \q Las laderas empinadas se convertirán en tierra ancha y llana.

fr.L: Toute vallée sera élevée, \q et toute montagne et colline seront abaissées, \q et le [terrain] accidenté deviendra une terre plane, \q et les escarpements une large plaine.
fr.B: Toute vallée se relèvera, \q toute montagne et toute colline s’abaisseront ; \q le sol bosselé deviendra plat, \q et les hauteurs escarpées une plaine ouverte.
fr.R: Toutes les vallées seront remplies. \q Toutes les montagnes et les collines seront abaissées. \q Les terrains bosselés deviendront plats. \q Les pentes raides deviendront de larges terres plates.

sw.L: Kila bonde litainuliwa, \q na kila mlima na kilima vitashushwa, \q na [ardhi] isiyo sawa itakuwa nchi tambarare, \q na mahali palipoparuza [patakuwa] uwanda mpana.
sw.B: Kila bonde litainuka, \q na kila mlima na kilima vitashuka; \q ardhi iliyovunjikavunjika itasawazishwa, \q na vilima vikali vitakuwa uwanda wazi.
sw.R: Kila bonde litainuliwa. \q Kila mlima na kilima kitashushwa. \q Ardhi yenye mabonde na vilima itasawazishwa. \q Matuta makali yatakuwa nchi pana tambarare.

vi.L: Mọi thung lũng sẽ được nâng lên, \q và mọi núi và đồi sẽ bị hạ thấp, \q và [đất] gập ghềnh sẽ thành đất bằng, \q và những chỗ hiểm trở thành đồng bằng rộng.
vi.B: Mọi thung lũng sẽ dâng lên, \q mọi núi và đồi sẽ hạ xuống; \q đất gồ ghề sẽ được san phẳng, \q và những dãy đồi lởm chởm sẽ thành đồng bằng thoáng rộng.
vi.R: Mọi thung lũng sẽ được nâng lên. \q Mọi núi và đồi sẽ được hạ thấp. \q Đất đồi gồ ghề sẽ được làm cho bằng phẳng. \q Những sườn núi dốc đứng sẽ thành vùng đất rộng và bằng.

decisions.choice: the uneven ground ... the rugged places: hilly, broken country that is hard to cross
decisions.reason: The first word describes ground that is humped or steep; the second is used only here and seems to mean rough ridges or crags. Both stand for whatever makes the road hard.

decisions.choice: the landscape itself is reshaped for God's coming
decisions.reason: The lifting and lowering is part of the road-building picture of verse 3, but the same language describes God bringing down the proud and raising the lowly (2:12-15; Luke 3:5).

source.text: וְנִגְלָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֑ה וְרָא֤וּ כָל־בָּשָׂר֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And will be revealed [the] glory of Yahweh, and will see [it] all flesh together, for [the] mouth of Yahweh has spoken.

en.L: And the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be revealed, \q and all flesh together will see [it], \q for the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken.
en.B: The glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be unveiled, \q and every human being will see it together, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken it with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own mouth.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will show {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, \q and all people everywhere will see it together. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} has said so.

es.L: Y la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} será revelada, \q y toda carne juntamente [la] verá, \q porque la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ha hablado.
es.B: La gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se manifestará, \q y todo ser humano la verá a una, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ha dicho con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia boca.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mostrará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, \q y todas las personas de todas partes la verán juntas. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mismo lo ha dicho.

fr.L: Et la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sera révélée, \q et toute chair ensemble [la] verra, \q car la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a parlé.
fr.B: La gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sera dévoilée, \q et tous les humains ensemble la verront, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a dit de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre bouche.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} montrera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, \q et tous les gens, partout, la verront ensemble. \q C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} qui l’a dit.

sw.L: Na utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utafunuliwa, \q na kila mwili pamoja utauona, \q kwa maana kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kimesema.
sw.B: Utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utafunuliwa, \q na wanadamu wote watauona pamoja, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema kwa kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.
sw.R: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakapoonyesha utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q na watu wote kila mahali watauona pamoja. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} amesema hivyo.

vi.L: Và vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ được bày tỏ, \q và mọi xác thịt cùng nhau sẽ thấy [điều ấy], \q vì miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.B: Vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ được tỏ ra, \q và mọi người cùng nhau sẽ thấy, \q vì chính miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.R: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bày tỏ vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và mọi người khắp nơi sẽ cùng nhau nhìn thấy. \q Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán như vậy.

decisions.choice: all flesh: all people, every human being
decisions.reason: "Flesh" stands for humankind in its frailty, the theme of verses 6-8.

decisions.choice: all flesh will see it together (the Hebrew text)
alternatives: all flesh will see the salvation of God
decisions.reason: The Septuagint reads "and all flesh will see the salvation of God", and Luke 3:6 quotes that form. The Hebrew leaves the object unstated: what all see is the LORD's glory.

decisions.choice: the mouth of the LORD has spoken: the promise is certain because God himself has said it
decisions.reason: The same closing formula seals promises in 1:20 and 58:14.

decisions.choice: toda carne (L); todo ser humano (B)
decisions.reason: As Luke 3:6 published: "toda carne" at L and "todo ser humano" at B; the Hebrew says the glory will be seen, where Luke follows the Greek "salvation of God".

decisions.choice: "kila mwili" (L)
decisions.reason: "All flesh" is "kila mwili" at Literal, the phrase of the published Luke 3:6 when it quotes this verse; Balanced and Readable say "all people".

decisions.choice: "mọi xác thịt"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "all flesh", as Luke 3:6 L has "mọi xác thịt"; Balanced and Readable say "mọi người", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "chính miệng CHÚA" (B); "Chính CHÚA" (R), with no pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable add a spanned "his" / "himself"; Vietnamese gives the emphasis with "chính", which is not a pronoun.

source.text: ק֚וֹל אֹמֵ֣ר קְרָ֔א וְאָמַ֖ר מָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א כָּל־הַבָּשָׂ֣ר חָצִ֔יר וְכָל־חַסְדּ֖וֹ כְּצִ֥יץ הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: A voice saying, call; and he said, what will I call? All the flesh [is] grass, and all its loyalty like [the] flower of the field.

en.L: A voice is saying, "Call out." \q And [one] said, "What will I call out?" \q All flesh [is] grass, \q and all its loyalty [is] like the flower of the field.
en.B: A voice says, "Call out." \q And someone answered, "What should I call out?" \q Humankind is grass, \q and all its loyalty is like a wildflower.
en.R: A voice said, "Shout out a message." \q Someone asked, "What message should I shout?" \q Every person is like grass. \q Even their faithfulness lasts no longer than a wildflower.

es.L: Una voz dice: «Clama». \q Y [uno] dijo: «¿Qué he de clamar?». \q Toda carne [es] hierba, \q y toda su lealtad [es] como la flor del campo.
es.B: Una voz dice: «Grita». \q Y alguien respondió: «¿Qué debo gritar?». \q La humanidad es hierba, \q y toda su lealtad es como una flor del campo.
es.R: Una voz dijo: «Grita un mensaje». \q Alguien preguntó: «¿Qué mensaje debo gritar?». \q Toda persona es como la hierba. \q Hasta su fidelidad dura tan poco como una flor del campo.

fr.L: Une voix dit : « Crie. » \q Et [quelqu’un] a dit : « Que crierai-je ? » \q Toute chair [est] de l’herbe, \q et toute sa loyauté [est] comme la fleur des champs.
fr.B: Une voix dit : « Proclame ! » \q Et quelqu’un a répondu : « Que dois-je proclamer ? » \q L’humanité n’est que de l’herbe, \q et toute sa loyauté est comme une fleur des champs.
fr.R: Une voix a dit : « Crie un message. » \q Quelqu’un a demandé : « Quel message dois-je crier ? » \q Tout être humain est comme l’herbe. \q Même sa fidélité ne dure pas plus longtemps qu’une fleur sauvage.

sw.L: Sauti inasema, "Paza sauti." \q Naye [mmoja] akasema, "Nipaze sauti kusema nini?" \q Kila mwili [ni] nyasi, \q na uaminifu wake wote [ni] kama ua la shambani.
sw.B: Sauti inasema, "Paza sauti." \q Mtu mmoja akajibu, "Nipaze sauti nikisema nini?" \q Wanadamu ni nyasi, \q na uaminifu wao wote ni kama ua la porini.
sw.R: Sauti ilisema, "Tangaza ujumbe kwa sauti." \q Mtu mmoja akauliza, "Nitangaze ujumbe gani?" \q Kila mtu ni kama nyasi. \q Hata uaminifu wao haudumu kuliko ua la porini.

vi.L: Có tiếng nói: "Hãy kêu lên." \q Và [có người] nói: "Tôi sẽ kêu lên điều gì?" \q Mọi xác thịt [là] cỏ, \q và mọi sự trung tín của nó [như] hoa ngoài đồng.
vi.B: Có tiếng phán: "Hãy kêu lên." \q Và có người đáp: "Tôi phải kêu lên điều gì?" \q Loài người là cỏ, \q và mọi lòng trung tín của họ như hoa dại ngoài đồng.
vi.R: Có tiếng nói: "Hãy rao lên một sứ điệp." \q Có người hỏi: "Tôi phải rao sứ điệp gì?" \q Mọi người đều như cỏ. \q Ngay cả lòng trung thành của họ cũng chẳng lâu hơn một bông hoa dại.

decisions.choice: and someone said (the Hebrew text)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "and he said", with no subject named, so a second speaker answers. The Great Isaiah Scroll (1QIsa-a) and the Septuagint read "and I said", making the prophet the one who asks.

decisions.choice: its loyalty: the faithfulness and devotion people show, which does not last
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for God's loyal love; said of people it means their faithfulness or kindness, which is as short-lived as morning dew (Hosea 6:4). The Septuagint has "glory", and 1 Peter 1:24 quotes that form.

decisions.choice: the answer in verses 6-8 does not say who speaks it
decisions.reason: The words "all flesh is grass" may be the voice's reply, or the questioner's complaint that the message seems hopeless; verse 8 answers it either way.

decisions.choice: lasts no longer than a wildflower
decisions.reason: Readable states the point of the comparison, which verses 7-8 make plain.

decisions.choice: lealtad
decisions.reason: Hesed said of people is their loyalty, as the English; 1 Peter 1:24 has "gloria" from the Greek, which is not followed here.

decisions.choice: "nyasi", "ua"
decisions.reason: 1 Peter 1:24-25 quotes verses 6-8; the published Swahili there has "nyasi" and "ua", so those words are kept here and in verses 7-8, while "loyalty" follows the Hebrew ("uaminifu") rather than the Greek "glory".

decisions.choice: "sa loyauté" (L, B), "sa fidélité" (R) for ḥesed
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is ḥesed, the loyalty people show; 1 Peter quotes the Greek's "glory", so French follows the Hebrew here and keeps "toute chair ... l'herbe ... la fleur" so the quotation can still be seen.

decisions.choice: "sự trung tín" / "lòng trung tín"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is hesed, loyalty, as the meaning decision says; 1 Peter quotes the Greek "glory", which is not followed here. "Mọi xác thịt" and "cỏ" keep the quotation recognisable.

source.text: יָבֵ֤שׁ חָצִיר֙ נָ֣בֵֽל צִ֔יץ כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה נָ֣שְׁבָה בּ֑וֹ אָכֵ֥ן חָצִ֖יר הָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Dries up grass, withers flower, for [the] breath of Yahweh blows on it; truly the people [is] grass.

en.L: Grass dries up, [the] flower wilts, \q for the wind of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} blows on it; \q truly the people [are] grass.
en.B: The grass dries out and the flower droops \q when the wind of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} blows across it; \q yes, the people are mere grass.
en.R: Grass dries up and flowers wilt \q when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sends {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wind across them. \q The people are like that grass.

es.L: La hierba se seca, la flor se marchita, \q porque el soplo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} sopla sobre ella; \q ciertamente el pueblo [es] hierba.
es.B: La hierba se seca y la flor se marchita \q cuando el viento {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} sopla sobre ella; \q sí, el pueblo es pura hierba.
es.R: La hierba se seca y las flores se marchitan \q cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envía {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} viento sobre ellas. \q La gente es como esa hierba.

fr.L: L’herbe sèche, la fleur se fane, \q car le souffle {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} passe sur elle ; \q vraiment, le peuple [est] de l’herbe.
fr.B: L’herbe se dessèche et la fleur se fane \q quand le vent {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} souffle sur elle ; \q oui, le peuple n’est que de l’herbe.
fr.R: L’herbe sèche et les fleurs se fanent \q quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} envoie {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} vent sur elles. \q Les gens sont comme cette herbe.

sw.L: Nyasi hukauka, ua hunyauka, \q kwa maana upepo wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huvuma juu yake; \q hakika watu [ni] nyasi.
sw.B: Nyasi hukauka na ua hunyauka \q upepo wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} unapovuma juu yake; \q naam, watu ni nyasi tu.
sw.R: Nyasi hukauka na maua hunyauka \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapopeleka upepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu yake. \q Watu ni kama nyasi hiyo.

vi.L: Cỏ khô héo, hoa tàn úa, \q vì hơi gió của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thổi trên nó; \q thật, dân [là] cỏ.
vi.B: Cỏ khô đi, hoa rũ xuống \q khi gió của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thổi ngang qua; \q phải, dân chỉ là cỏ.
vi.R: Cỏ khô héo và hoa tàn úa \q khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho gió của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thổi qua. \q Loài người cũng giống như cỏ ấy.

decisions.choice: the breath of the LORD: his wind, pictured as the hot desert wind that scorches plants
decisions.reason: The word means both breath and wind. The dry east wind withers grass in a day (Hosea 13:15; Psalm 103:15-16).

decisions.choice: verse 7 belongs to the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The Septuagint does not have this verse; it moves straight to "the grass withered" of verse 8, and 1 Peter 1:24-25 quotes that shorter form. In the Great Isaiah Scroll the words seem to have been added between the lines by a corrector. The repeated wording of verses 7 and 8 explains how a copyist's eye could skip from one to the other.

decisions.choice: the people: human beings in general, or Israel
decisions.reason: After "all flesh" in verse 6 the word most likely means humankind; it can also mean God's own people, who are no less frail.

decisions.choice: sends {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wind
decisions.reason: Readable makes the LORD the one who sends the wind, as the Hebrew implies.

source.text: יָבֵ֥שׁ חָצִ֖יר נָ֣בֵֽל צִ֑יץ וּדְבַר־אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יָק֥וּם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Dries up grass, withers flower, and [the] word of our God will stand forever.

en.L: Grass dries up, [the] flower wilts, \q but the word of our God will stand forever.
en.B: Grass dries out and flowers droop, \q but the word of our God holds firm for all time.
en.R: Grass dries up and flowers wilt. \q But what our God says will last forever.

es.L: La hierba se seca, la flor se marchita, \q pero la palabra de nuestro Dios permanecerá para siempre.
es.B: La hierba se seca y las flores se marchitan, \q pero la palabra de nuestro Dios se mantiene firme para siempre.
es.R: La hierba se seca y las flores se marchitan. \q Pero lo que dice nuestro Dios durará para siempre.

fr.L: L’herbe sèche, la fleur se fane, \q mais la parole de notre Dieu demeurera pour toujours.
fr.B: L’herbe se dessèche et les fleurs se fanent, \q mais la parole de notre Dieu tient bon à jamais.
fr.R: L’herbe sèche et les fleurs se fanent. \q Mais ce que dit notre Dieu durera toujours.

sw.L: Nyasi hukauka, ua hunyauka, \q lakini neno la Mungu wetu litasimama milele.
sw.B: Nyasi hukauka na maua hunyauka, \q lakini neno la Mungu wetu hudumu imara nyakati zote.
sw.R: Nyasi hukauka na maua hunyauka. \q Lakini anachosema Mungu wetu kitadumu milele.

vi.L: Cỏ khô héo, hoa tàn úa, \q nhưng lời của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta sẽ đứng vững đời đời.
vi.B: Cỏ khô đi, hoa rũ xuống, \q nhưng lời của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta còn vững bền mãi mãi.
vi.R: Cỏ khô héo và hoa tàn úa. \q Nhưng điều Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta phán sẽ còn mãi mãi.

decisions.choice: will stand: will remain valid and will come true
decisions.reason: The verb is used of God's plans and promises that are carried out (14:24; 46:10; Numbers 23:19).

decisions.choice: 1 Peter 1:24-25 quotes verses 6-8 and applies them to the good news that was preached
decisions.reason: Peter quotes the Septuagint form ("the word of the Lord remains forever") and says, "this is the word that was proclaimed to you."

decisions.choice: what our God says
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the word of our God" as what God says.

source.text: עַ֣ל הַר־גָּבֹ֤הַ עֲלִי־לָךְ֙ מְבַשֶּׂ֣רֶת צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֤ימִי בַכֹּ֨חַ֙ קוֹלֵ֔ךְ מְבַשֶּׂ֖רֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הָרִ֨ימִי֙ אַל־תִּירָ֔אִי אִמְרִי֙ לְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה הִנֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: On a mountain high go up for yourself, bearer of news Zion; lift up with strength your voice, bearer of news Jerusalem; lift [it] up, do not be afraid; say to [the] cities of Judah, here [is] your God.

en.L: Go up for yourself on a high mountain, bearer of good news, Zion; \q lift up your voice with strength, bearer of good news, Jerusalem; \q lift [it] up, do not be afraid; \q say to the cities of Judah, "Here [is] your God!"
en.B: Climb a high mountain, Zion, you who carry good news. \q Shout with all your strength, Jerusalem, you who carry good news. \q Shout and do not be afraid. \q Tell the towns of Judah, "Here is your God!"
en.R: People of Zion, you have good news to tell! Go up on a high mountain. \q People of Jerusalem, shout the good news as loud as you can. \q Shout it, and do not be afraid. \q Tell the towns of Judah, "Look, your God is here!"

es.L: Súbete a un monte alto, Sion, que anuncias buenas noticias; \q alza con fuerza tu voz, Jerusalén, que anuncias buenas noticias; \q álzala, no temas; \q di a las ciudades de Judá: «¡He aquí {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}!».
es.B: Sube a un monte alto, Sion, tú que traes la buena noticia. \q Grita con todas tus fuerzas, Jerusalén, tú que traes la buena noticia. \q Grita y no tengas miedo. \q Diles a los pueblos de Judá: «¡Aquí está {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}!».
es.R: Pueblo de Sion, tienes buenas noticias que contar. Sube a un monte alto. \q Pueblo de Jerusalén, grita la buena noticia tan fuerte como puedas. \q Grítala y no tengas miedo. \q Diles a los pueblos de Judá: «¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} está aquí!».

fr.L: Monte sur une haute montagne, porteuse de bonne nouvelle, Sion ; \q élève avec force ta voix, porteuse de bonne nouvelle, Jérusalem ; \q élève[-la], n’aie pas peur ; \q dis aux villes de Juda : « Voici votre Dieu ! »
fr.B: Gravis une haute montagne, Sion, messagère de bonnes nouvelles. \q Crie de toutes tes forces, Jérusalem, messagère de bonnes nouvelles. \q Crie, n’aie pas peur. \q Dis aux villes de Juda : « Voici votre Dieu ! »
fr.R: Habitants de Sion, vous avez une bonne nouvelle à annoncer ! Montez sur une haute montagne. \q Habitants de Jérusalem, criez la bonne nouvelle aussi fort que vous pouvez. \q Criez-la, n’ayez pas peur. \q Dites aux villes de Juda : « Regardez, votre Dieu est là ! »

sw.L: Jipandie juu ya mlima mrefu, ewe unayeleta habari njema, Sayuni; \q inua sauti yako kwa nguvu, ewe unayeleta habari njema, Yerusalemu; \q iinue, usiogope; \q iambie miji ya Yuda, "Tazama, Mungu wenu!"
sw.B: Panda juu ya mlima mrefu, ee Sayuni, wewe unayeleta habari njema. \q Paza sauti kwa nguvu zako zote, ee Yerusalemu, wewe unayeleta habari njema. \q Paza sauti wala usiogope. \q Iambie miji ya Yuda, "Mungu wenu yuko hapa!"
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Sayuni, mna habari njema za kutangaza! Pandeni juu ya mlima mrefu. \q Enyi watu wa Yerusalemu, tangazeni habari njema kwa sauti kubwa kadiri mwezavyo. \q Ipazeni wala msiogope. \q Iambieni miji ya Yuda, "Tazameni, Mungu wenu yuko hapa!"

vi.L: Hãy tự leo lên một núi cao, hỡi Si-ôn, người đem tin lành; \q hãy mạnh mẽ cất tiếng lên, hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, người đem tin lành; \q hãy cất [tiếng] lên, đừng sợ; \q hãy nói với các thành của Giu-đa: "Đây [là] Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi!"
vi.B: Hỡi Si-ôn, người mang tin lành, hãy leo lên một núi cao. \q Hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, người mang tin lành, hãy dốc hết sức mà cất tiếng. \q Hãy cất tiếng lên, đừng sợ. \q Hãy nói với các thành của Giu-đa: "Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi đây!"
vi.R: Hỡi dân Si-ôn, các ngươi có tin vui để báo! Hãy lên một ngọn núi cao. \q Hỡi dân Giê-ru-sa-lem, hãy hết sức lớn tiếng loan báo tin vui. \q Hãy loan báo và đừng sợ. \q Hãy nói với các thành của Giu-đa: "Kìa, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi đã đến!"

decisions.choice: bearer of good news, Zion: Zion herself is the messenger who brings the news to the towns of Judah
alternatives: you who bring good news to Zion
decisions.reason: The word for the messenger is feminine, like Zion and Jerusalem, and the message is sent to "the cities of Judah". The phrase can also be read "you who bring good news to Zion", making the messenger someone else (compare 41:27; 52:7).

decisions.choice: bearer of good news: one who announces news of victory or rescue
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a runner bringing news from battle (2 Samuel 18:19-20) and of announcing God's salvation (52:7; 61:1). The Greek word for "gospel" translates it in the Septuagint.

decisions.choice: Here is your God: God is arriving in person
decisions.reason: The word "here!" points to something present; verses 10-11 describe his arrival.

decisions.choice: People of Zion ... People of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Readable says that the cities stand for their people (see the note on Daughter Zion at 1:8).

decisions.choice: Sion, que anuncias buenas noticias (L); Sion, tú que traes la buena noticia (B); pueblo de Sion, tienes buenas noticias que contar (R)
decisions.reason: The feminine bearer of good news, as the terms note sets it; Zion is "tú", and the towns of Judah are addressed in the plural inside the quotation.

decisions.choice: "unayeleta habari njema" (L, B); "mna habari njema za kutangaza" (R)
decisions.reason: The bearer of good news (mebasser) is "anayeleta habari njema", as Romans 10:15 and the terms note; Readable follows the English Readable in speaking to the people of Zion as the ones who carry it, so the terms note's "mjumbe mwenye habari njema" is kept for 52:7.

decisions.choice: "porteuse de bonne nouvelle" (L), "messagère de bonnes nouvelles" (B), "vous avez une bonne nouvelle à annoncer" (R) for mebasseret
decisions.reason: The Hebrew participle is feminine, for Zion herself (m1); French keeps the feminine of the terms note's "messager de bonnes nouvelles". Readable speaks to the people, as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: "người đem tin lành" (L); "người mang tin lành" (B); "tin vui" (R), lowercase
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for mebasser: a bearer of good news, lowercase, not "Tin Lành", the gospel; Readable says "tin vui", as Romans 10:15 R does.

source.text: הִנֵּ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ בְּחָזָ֣ק יָב֔וֹא וּזְרֹע֖וֹ מֹ֣שְׁלָה ל֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂכָרוֹ֙ אִתּ֔וֹ וּפְעֻלָּת֖וֹ לְפָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Here [is the] Lord Yahweh, as a strong [one] he will come, and his arm [is] ruling for him; here, his wages [are] with him, and his recompense before him.

en.L: Here [is] the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}! As a mighty one {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arm rules for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q here, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wages [are] with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} recompense [is] before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Look, the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} is coming in power, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arm will rule for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Look, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} prize with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has won goes ahead of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Look! The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} is coming with power. \q He will rule by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own strength. \q Look! He is bringing with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the reward {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has won. \q What {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has earned goes in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: ¡He aquí el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}! Como poderoso viene, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} brazo gobierna por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q he aquí, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} salario [está] con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} recompensa delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Mira, el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} viene con poder, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} brazo gobernará por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q Mira, trae consigo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} premio; \q lo que ha ganado va delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: ¡Mira! El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} viene con poder. \q Gobernará con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia fuerza. \q ¡Mira! Trae consigo la recompensa que ha ganado. \q Lo que se ha ganado va delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Voici le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ! Comme un puissant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient, \q et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras gouverne pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q voici, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} salaire [est] avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} rétribution [est] devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Voici le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} qui vient avec puissance, \q et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras régnera pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Voici : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} apporte avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} butin ; \q ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a gagné marche devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Regardez ! Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} arrive avec puissance. \q Il régnera par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre force. \q Regardez ! Il apporte avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} la récompense qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a gagnée. \q Ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a remporté marche devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Tazama, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}! Anakuja kama mwenye nguvu, \q na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unatawala kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q tazama, ujira {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [uko] pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, \q na malipo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} [yako] mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Tazama, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} anakuja kwa uweza, \q na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} utatawala kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Tazama, analeta tuzo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}; \q alichokishinda kinatangulia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Tazama! Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} anakuja na nguvu. \q Atatawala kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} mwenyewe. \q Tazama! Analeta pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} tuzo aliloshinda. \q Alichokipata kinatangulia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Kìa, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Ngài đến như một Đấng Quyền Năng, \q và cánh tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cai trị cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q kìa, phần thưởng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và sự báo đáp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [đi] trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Kìa, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang đến trong quyền năng, \q và cánh tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cai trị cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mang theo phần thưởng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q những gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chiến thắng được đi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hãy xem! Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang đến với quyền năng. \q Ngài sẽ cai trị bằng chính sức mạnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Hãy xem! Ngài mang theo phần thưởng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giành được. \q Những gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đạt được đi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: his arm rules for him: he wins and holds power by his own strength
decisions.reason: The arm is a picture of strength in action, as at the exodus (Exodus 6:6; Deuteronomy 26:8; Isaiah 51:9; 52:10).

decisions.choice: his wages and recompense: what he has won, most likely his rescued people, whom he brings home like a victor bringing the spoils
alternatives: the reward he gives his people
decisions.reason: The same words return in 62:11, where they accompany Zion's salvation. Here the next verse shows him carrying his flock. They could also mean the reward he gives to others.

decisions.choice: He will rule by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own strength
decisions.reason: Readable explains the image of the arm.

source.text: כְּרֹעֶה֙ עֶדְר֣וֹ יִרְעֶ֔ה בִּזְרֹעוֹ֙ יְקַבֵּ֣ץ טְלָאִ֔ים וּבְחֵיק֖וֹ יִשָּׂ֑א עָל֖וֹת יְנַהֵֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Like a shepherd his flock he will shepherd; in his arm he will gather lambs, and in his bosom he will carry [them]; nursing [ewes] he will lead.

en.L: Like a shepherd {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will tend {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock; \q in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arm {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will gather lambs, \q and in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} bosom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will carry [them]; \q nursing [ewes] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will lead.
en.B: Like a shepherd {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will pasture {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock. \q He will gather the lambs into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arm \q and carry them close against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} chest, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will lead the nursing ewes with care.
en.R: He will take care of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people the way a shepherd takes care of sheep. \q He will pick up the lambs in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arms and hold them close. \q He will gently guide the mother sheep that are feeding their young.

es.L: Como pastor {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} apacentará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rebaño; \q en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} brazo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} recogerá los corderos, \q y en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} seno [los] llevará; \q a las [ovejas] que crían {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} conducirá.
es.B: Como un pastor {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} apacentará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rebaño. \q Reunirá a los corderos en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} brazo \q y los llevará junto a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pecho, \q y guiará con cuidado a las ovejas que crían.
es.R: Cuidará de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo como un pastor cuida de sus ovejas. \q Tomará en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} brazos a los corderos y los llevará junto a {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}}. \q Guiará con suavidad a las ovejas que están criando a sus corderitos.

fr.L: Comme un berger, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera paître {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau ; \q dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rassemblera les agneaux, \q et sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sein {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [les] portera ; \q les [brebis] qui allaitent, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les conduira.
fr.B: Comme un berger, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mènera paître {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau. \q Il prendra les agneaux dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras \q et les portera serrés contre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} poitrine, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} guidera avec soin les brebis qui allaitent.
fr.R: Il prendra soin de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple comme un berger prend soin de ses moutons. \q Il prendra les agneaux dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} bras et les tiendra contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Il conduira doucement les brebis qui nourrissent leurs petits.

sw.L: Kama mchungaji atalichunga kundi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} atawakusanya wana-kondoo, \q na kifuani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} atawabeba; \q [kondoo] wanaonyonyesha atawaongoza.
sw.B: Kama mchungaji atalilisha kundi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. \q Atawakusanya wana-kondoo mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} \q na kuwabeba karibu na kifua {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}, \q naye atawaongoza kwa uangalifu kondoo wanaonyonyesha.
sw.R: Atawatunza watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kama mchungaji anavyowatunza kondoo. \q Atawabeba wana-kondoo mikononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} na kuwashika karibu. \q Atawaongoza kwa upole kondoo mama wanaonyonyesha watoto wao.

vi.L: Như người chăn chiên, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chăn bầy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q trong cánh tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ gom các chiên con, \q và trong lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ẵm [chúng]; \q các chiên mẹ đang cho bú, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ dẫn dắt.
vi.B: Như người chăn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chăn giữ bầy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài sẽ gom các chiên con vào cánh tay mình \q và ẵm chúng sát vào lòng, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nhẹ nhàng dẫn dắt các chiên mẹ đang cho con bú.
vi.R: Ngài sẽ chăm sóc dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như người chăn chăm sóc bầy chiên. \q Ngài sẽ bế các chiên con trong tay và ôm sát vào lòng. \q Ngài sẽ nhẹ nhàng dẫn dắt những chiên mẹ đang cho con bú.

decisions.choice: like a shepherd: the LORD cares for his people as a shepherd for his flock
decisions.reason: God is the shepherd of Israel in Genesis 49:24, Psalm 23:1, Psalm 80:2 and Ezekiel 34:11-16; Jesus takes up the picture in John 10:11.

decisions.choice: he will lead: guide gently, especially to water and rest
decisions.reason: The verb is used of leading a flock to water and to pasture (Psalm 23:2; Isaiah 49:10). The ewes that are nursing their lambs cannot be hurried (Genesis 33:13).

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people
decisions.reason: Readable names the flock as God's people.

source.text: מִֽי־מָדַ֨ד בְּשָׁעֳל֜וֹ מַ֗יִם וְשָׁמַ֨יִם֙ בַּזֶּ֣רֶת תִּכֵּ֔ן וְכָ֥ל בַּשָּׁלִ֖שׁ עֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָׁקַ֤ל בַּפֶּ֨לֶס֙ הָרִ֔ים וּגְבָע֖וֹת בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Who has measured in his hollow hand [the] waters, and [the] heavens with a span marked off, and held in a third-measure [the] dust of the earth, and weighed with a scale [the] mountains, and [the] hills in balances?

en.L: Who has measured in the hollow of his hand [the] waters, and marked off [the] heavens with a span, \q and held in a measure the dust of the earth, \q and weighed [the] mountains with a scale, \q and [the] hills in balances?
en.B: Who has measured the seas in the cup of his hand, or marked off the sky with the stretch of his fingers? \q Who has gathered the dust of the earth into a basket, \q or set the mountains on a scale \q and the hills on a pair of balances?
en.R: Who could measure all the oceans by holding them in his hand? Who could measure the sky with the width of his hand? \q Who could put all the dust of the earth into a basket? \q Who could weigh the mountains and hills on a scale?

es.L: ¿Quién midió las aguas en el hueco de su mano, y marcó los cielos con un palmo, \q y contuvo en una medida el polvo de la tierra, \q y pesó los montes con la báscula, \q y las colinas con la balanza?
es.B: ¿Quién ha medido los mares en el hueco de su mano, o ha marcado el cielo con el ancho de sus dedos? \q ¿Quién ha juntado el polvo de la tierra en una canasta, \q o ha puesto los montes en una báscula \q y las colinas en una balanza?
es.R: ¿Quién podría medir todos los océanos sosteniéndolos en la mano? ¿Quién podría medir el cielo con el ancho de su mano? \q ¿Quién podría meter todo el polvo de la tierra en una canasta? \q ¿Quién podría pesar los montes y las colinas en una báscula?

fr.L: Qui a mesuré dans le creux de sa main les eaux, et réglé les cieux avec l’empan, \q et contenu dans une mesure la poussière de la terre, \q et pesé les montagnes à la balance, \q et les collines aux plateaux de la balance ?
fr.B: Qui a mesuré les mers dans le creux de sa main, ou évalué le ciel d’un écart de ses doigts ? \q Qui a rassemblé la poussière de la terre dans un panier, \q ou posé les montagnes sur une balance \q et les collines sur ses deux plateaux ?
fr.R: Qui pourrait mesurer tous les océans en les tenant dans sa main ? Qui pourrait mesurer le ciel avec la largeur de sa main ? \q Qui pourrait mettre toute la poussière de la terre dans un panier ? \q Qui pourrait peser les montagnes et les collines sur une balance ?

sw.L: Ni nani aliyepima maji katika konzi ya mkono wake, na kuzipima mbingu kwa shibiri, \q na kuyatia mavumbi ya dunia katika kipimo, \q na kuipima milima kwa mizani, \q na vilima kwa vipimo?
sw.B: Ni nani aliyeipima bahari katika kiganja cha mkono wake, au kuzipima mbingu kwa upana wa vidole vyake vilivyotandazwa? \q Ni nani aliyeyakusanya mavumbi ya dunia katika kikapu, \q au kuiweka milima juu ya mizani \q na vilima juu ya vipimo viwili?
sw.R: Ni nani anayeweza kuipima bahari yote kwa kuishika mkononi mwake? Ni nani anayeweza kuipima anga kwa upana wa mkono wake? \q Ni nani anayeweza kuyatia mavumbi yote ya dunia katika kikapu? \q Ni nani anayeweza kuipima milima na vilima kwa mizani?

vi.L: Ai đã đo nước trong lòng bàn tay mình, và lấy gang tay đo các tầng trời, \q và đong bụi đất trong cái đấu, \q và cân núi bằng cân móc, \q và đồi bằng cân đĩa?
vi.B: Ai đã đong biển cả trong lòng bàn tay, hay lấy gang tay đo bầu trời? \q Ai đã gom bụi đất vào một cái thúng, \q hay đặt núi lên cân \q và đồi lên bàn cân?
vi.R: Ai có thể đo hết nước biển bằng cách bụm trong tay? Ai có thể đo bầu trời bằng bề rộng bàn tay? \q Ai có thể bỏ hết bụi đất trên thế gian vào một cái thúng? \q Ai có thể cân núi và đồi trên bàn cân?

decisions.choice: who? a question that expects the answer "no one but the LORD"
decisions.reason: The questions of verses 12-14 are like God's questions to Job (Job 38:4-11): no human could do these things, and God did them with ease.

decisions.choice: a span: the width of a spread hand, about nine inches; a measure: a dry measure, literally "a third" of a larger unit
decisions.reason: Both are small household measures. The point is the contrast: God handles the whole world as if it were a handful of grain.

decisions.choice: a basket
decisions.reason: Balanced uses a familiar container for the small dry measure; Literal keeps "a measure".

decisions.choice: "shibiri"
decisions.reason: The span of a hand is "shibiri", a Swahili measure of the same length, so no units setting is needed; the English has none here either.

decisions.choice: "l'empan" at Literal for zeret
decisions.reason: "Empan" is the French name of the measure, the span of the spread hand; Balanced and Readable describe it.

decisions.choice: "gang tay"; "cái đấu" (L), "cái thúng" (B)
decisions.reason: The span and the third-measure are small household measures given as pictures, with no units span in the English; Vietnamese uses the familiar handspan and a common dry measure.

source.text: מִֽי־תִכֵּ֥ן אֶת־ר֖וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה וְאִ֥ישׁ עֲצָת֖וֹ יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Who has measured the spirit of Yahweh, and [the] man of his counsel will he inform him?

en.L: Who has gauged the spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q or [as] the man of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} counsel informs {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.B: Who has taken the measure of the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? \q What adviser of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} has ever taught {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.R: Who can understand the mind of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? \q Who has ever given {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} advice or taught {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} anything?

es.L: ¿Quién midió el espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q o [como] su consejero {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} informó?
es.B: ¿Quién ha tomado la medida del Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? \q ¿Qué consejero suyo {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ha enseñado jamás?
es.R: ¿Quién puede entender la mente {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? \q ¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ha dado alguna vez un consejo o {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ha enseñado algo?

fr.L: Qui a sondé l’esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q ou [comme] l’homme de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} conseil {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a-t-il instruit ?
fr.B: Qui a pris la mesure de l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? \q Quel conseiller {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a jamais appris quelque chose ?
fr.R: Qui peut comprendre la pensée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? \q Qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a jamais donné un conseil ou {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a appris quelque chose ?

sw.L: Ni nani aliyeipima roho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q au [kama] mshauri {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} anavyomjulisha?
sw.B: Ni nani aliyempima Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? \q Ni mshauri gani {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} aliyewahi kumfundisha?
sw.R: Ni nani anayeweza kuielewa akili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? \q Ni nani aliyewahi kumpa ushauri au kumfundisha chochote?

vi.L: Ai đã đo lường thần linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q hay [là] người mưu sĩ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chỉ dạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.B: Ai đã thấu hiểu được Thần của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? \q Mưu sĩ nào của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã từng chỉ dạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.R: Ai có thể hiểu được tâm trí của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? \q Ai đã từng khuyên bảo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hay dạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} điều gì?

decisions.choice: measured the spirit of the LORD: fully grasped the LORD's mind and purposes
alternatives: directed the Spirit of the LORD
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for marking off the sky in verse 12. Here the LORD's spirit stands for his mind and will, so no one can take its measure. The Septuagint has "who has known the mind of the Lord?", and Paul quotes that form in Romans 11:34 and 1 Corinthians 2:16.

decisions.choice: or as his counselor informs him: who has ever advised him as a counselor would a king?
decisions.reason: Kings had counselors (1 Kings 12:6); the LORD needs none (Job 21:22; Romans 11:34).

decisions.choice: the mind
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "spirit" here, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "akili ya BWANA" (R); "mshauri wake"
decisions.reason: Readable says "mind" as the English does, with "akili", the word of the published Romans 11:34, which quotes this verse from the Greek; "mshauri wake" is also the word there.

decisions.choice: "thần linh" (L), lowercase; "Thần" (B), capitalised
decisions.reason: The English capitalises "Spirit" only at Balanced; Vietnamese follows it, keeping Literal's lowercase "thần linh" for the LORD's mind and will, as the meaning decision explains.

source.text: אֶת־מִ֤י נוֹעָץ֙ וַיְבִינֵ֔הוּ וַֽיְלַמְּדֵ֖הוּ בְּאֹ֣רַח מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וַיְלַמְּדֵ֣הוּ דַ֔עַת וְדֶ֥רֶךְ תְּבוּנ֖וֹת יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: With whom did he consult, and he gave him understanding and taught him in [the] path of justice and taught him knowledge, and [the] way of understandings made known to him?

en.L: With whom did {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} consult, and [who] gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} understanding \q and taught {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the path of justice, \q and taught {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} knowledge, \q and made known to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the way of understanding?
en.B: Whom did {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} ever ask for advice, so as to gain insight? \q Who trained {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the path of justice, \q or taught {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} knowledge, \q or pointed out to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the road to discernment?
en.R: Did {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} ever need to ask anyone for advice? \q Did anyone teach {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} what is right and fair? \q Did anyone teach {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} knows, \q or show {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} how to understand things?

es.L: ¿Con quién se aconsejó {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y [quién] {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dio entendimiento \q y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} enseñó la senda de la justicia, \q y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} enseñó conocimiento, \q y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} mostró el camino de la inteligencia?
es.B: ¿A quién le pidió {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} consejo para adquirir entendimiento? \q ¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} instruyó en la senda de la justicia, \q o {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} enseñó conocimiento, \q o {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} indicó el camino del discernimiento?
es.R: ¿Alguna vez necesitó {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} pedirle consejo a alguien? \q ¿Alguien {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} enseñó lo que es justo y correcto? \q ¿Alguien {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} enseñó lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sabe, \q o {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} mostró cómo entender las cosas?

fr.L: Avec qui {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} consulté, et [qui] {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a donné l’intelligence \q et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a instruit dans le sentier du droit, \q et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a enseigné la connaissance, \q et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a fait connaître le chemin de l’intelligence ?
fr.B: À qui a-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} jamais demandé conseil pour gagner en discernement ? \q Qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a formé au sentier du droit, \q ou {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a enseigné la connaissance, \q ou {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a montré la route de l’intelligence ?
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} jamais eu besoin de demander conseil à quelqu’un ? \q Quelqu’un {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a-t-il appris ce qui est juste et équitable ? \q Quelqu’un {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a-t-il enseigné ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sait, \q ou {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a-t-il montré comment comprendre les choses ?

sw.L: Alishauriana na nani, na [nani] aliyempa ufahamu \q na kumfundisha katika njia ya hukumu, \q na kumfundisha maarifa, \q na kumjulisha njia ya ufahamu?
sw.B: Ni nani aliyewahi kumwomba ushauri, ili apate busara? \q Ni nani aliyemfunza katika njia ya haki, \q au kumfundisha maarifa, \q au kumwonyesha njia ya utambuzi?
sw.R: Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwahi kuhitaji kumwomba mtu yeyote ushauri? \q Je, kuna mtu aliyemfundisha yaliyo sawa na ya haki? \q Je, kuna mtu aliyemfundisha anayoyajua, \q au kumwonyesha jinsi ya kuelewa mambo?

vi.L: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hỏi ý kiến ai, và [ai] đã ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sự hiểu biết, \q và dạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} con đường công lý, \q và dạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tri thức, \q và chỉ cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} con đường hiểu biết?
vi.B: Ngài đã từng hỏi ý ai để được sáng suốt? \q Ai đã dạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} con đường công lý, \q hay dạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tri thức, \q hay chỉ cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} con đường thông sáng?
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có bao giờ cần hỏi ý kiến ai không? \q Có ai dạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} điều gì là đúng và công bằng không? \q Có ai dạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết, \q hay chỉ cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cách hiểu biết mọi sự không?

decisions.choice: the path of justice: the right way to judge and govern
decisions.reason: Justice here is the right ordering of things, which God knows without being taught (Job 21:22; 1 Corinthians 2:16).

decisions.choice: Did {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} ever need to
decisions.reason: Readable names the LORD as the subject, which the Hebrew carries over from verse 13.

source.text: הֵ֤ן גּוֹיִם֙ כְּמַ֣ר מִדְּלִ֔י וּכְשַׁ֥חַק מֹאזְנַ֖יִם נֶחְשָׁ֑בוּ הֵ֥ן אִיִּ֖ים כַּדַּ֥ק יִטּֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, nations [are] like a drop from a bucket, and like dust of balances they are regarded; look, islands like fine dust he lifts.

en.L: Look, [the] nations [are] like a drop from a bucket, \q and like dust on [the] scales they are counted; \q look, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lifts [the] coastlands like fine dust.
en.B: The nations are no more than a drop falling from a bucket; \q they count as the dust left on a scale. \q He lifts up the coastlands like fine powder.
en.R: To God, the nations are like one drop of water from a bucket. \q They are like a bit of dust on a scale. \q He can lift up lands far away as if they were dust.

es.L: He aquí, [las] naciones [son] como una gota de un cubo, \q y como polvo de la balanza son tenidas; \q he aquí, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} alza [las] costas como polvo fino.
es.B: Las naciones no son más que una gota que cae de un cubo; \q cuentan como el polvo que queda en una balanza. \q Levanta las costas lejanas como polvo fino.
es.R: Para Dios, las naciones son como una gota de agua de un cubo. \q Son como un poco de polvo en una balanza. \q Puede levantar las tierras lejanas como si fueran polvo.

fr.L: Voici, les nations [sont] comme une goutte d’un seau, \q et comme la poussière d’une balance elles sont comptées ; \q voici, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soulève les îles comme une fine poussière.
fr.B: Les nations ne sont qu’une goutte qui tombe d’un seau ; \q elles comptent autant que la poussière restée sur une balance. \q Il soulève les îles lointaines comme une fine poudre.
fr.R: Pour Dieu, les nations sont comme une goutte d’eau tombée d’un seau. \q Elles sont comme un peu de poussière sur une balance. \q Il peut soulever les pays lointains comme si c’était de la poussière.

sw.L: Tazama, mataifa [ni] kama tone kutoka ndooni, \q na kama vumbi juu ya mizani yanahesabiwa; \q tazama, anavinyanyua visiwa kama vumbi laini.
sw.B: Mataifa si kitu zaidi ya tone linalodondoka kutoka ndooni; \q yanahesabiwa kama vumbi lililobaki juu ya mizani. \q Anaviinua visiwa kama unga laini.
sw.R: Kwa Mungu, mataifa ni kama tone moja la maji kutoka ndooni. \q Ni kama chembe ya vumbi juu ya mizani. \q Anaweza kuziinua nchi za mbali ng'ambo ya bahari kana kwamba ni vumbi.

vi.L: Kìa, các dân tộc [như] một giọt nước nơi thùng, \q và được kể như bụi trên cân; \q kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhấc các hải đảo lên như bụi mịn.
vi.B: Các dân tộc chẳng hơn gì một giọt nước rơi từ thùng; \q chúng được kể như hạt bụi còn sót trên cân. \q Ngài nhấc các hải đảo lên như bụi mịn.
vi.R: Đối với Đức Chúa Trời, các dân tộc chỉ như một giọt nước trong thùng. \q Chúng như một chút bụi trên bàn cân. \q Ngài có thể nhấc những miền xa bên kia biển lên như thể chúng là bụi.

decisions.choice: dust on the scales: a speck too small to change the weight
decisions.reason: A merchant ignored a little dust on his balance; the nations weigh no more than that before God.

decisions.choice: coastlands: the islands and coasts of the Mediterranean, the far edges of the known world
decisions.reason: The word stands for distant lands (41:1, 5; 42:4).

decisions.choice: To God
decisions.reason: Readable says from whose point of view the nations are so small, which verse 17 states.

source.text: וּלְבָנ֕וֹן אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י בָּעֵ֑ר וְחַיָּת֔וֹ אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י עוֹלָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And Lebanon [is] not enough [for] burning, and its animals [are] not enough [for a] burnt offering.

en.L: And Lebanon [is] not enough [for] burning, \q and its animals [are] not enough [for a] burnt offering.
en.B: Lebanon would not supply enough wood for the fire, \q nor its wild animals enough for a burnt offering.
en.R: All the trees in the forests of Lebanon would not make enough firewood for an offering to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q All the animals there would not be enough to sacrifice to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y el Líbano no [basta para] quemar, \q ni sus animales bastan [para] holocausto.
es.B: El Líbano no daría leña suficiente para el fuego, \q ni sus animales salvajes bastarían para un holocausto.
es.R: Todos los árboles de los bosques del Líbano no darían suficiente leña para una ofrenda a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q Todos los animales de allí no bastarían para ofrecerle un sacrificio.

fr.L: Et le Liban ne suffit pas [pour] le feu, \q et ses bêtes ne suffisent pas [pour] l’holocauste.
fr.B: Le Liban ne fournirait pas assez de bois pour le feu, \q ni ses bêtes sauvages assez de victimes pour un holocauste.
fr.R: Tous les arbres des forêts du Liban ne suffiraient pas à faire le feu d’une offrande pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Tous les animaux qui y vivent ne suffiraient pas pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} offrir un sacrifice.

sw.L: Na Lebanoni [haitoshi] kwa kuni, \q na wanyama wake hawatoshi [kwa] sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
sw.B: Lebanoni isingetoa kuni za kutosha kwa moto, \q wala wanyama wake wa porini wasingetosha kwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
sw.R: Miti yote ya misitu ya Lebanoni isingetosha kuwa kuni za sadaka ya kumtolea. \q Wanyama wote wa huko wasingetosha kumtolea dhabihu.

vi.L: Và Li-ban không đủ [để] đốt, \q và thú vật của nó không đủ [làm] tế lễ thiêu.
vi.B: Li-ban không đủ củi cho ngọn lửa, \q và thú rừng của nó không đủ cho một tế lễ thiêu.
vi.R: Tất cả cây cối trong rừng Li-ban cũng không đủ làm củi để dâng một tế lễ lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Tất cả thú vật ở đó cũng không đủ để dâng lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: Lebanon: the mountains north of Israel, famous for great forests of cedar
decisions.reason: Lebanon's forests were the largest anyone in Israel knew (2:13; 1 Kings 5:6). Even all of it would make too small a fire for an offering worthy of God.

decisions.choice: burnt offering: a sacrifice wholly burned on the altar
decisions.reason: The whole animal was burned as a gift to God (Leviticus 1:3-9).

decisions.choice: trees in the forests ... firewood ... to him
decisions.reason: Readable explains what Lebanon is known for and to whom the offering is made.

source.text: כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם כְּאַ֣יִן נֶגְדּ֑וֹ מֵאֶ֥פֶס וָתֹ֖הוּ נֶחְשְׁבוּ־לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: All the nations [are] as nothing before him; than nothingness and emptiness they are regarded by him.

en.L: All the nations [are] as nothing before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q as less than nothing and emptiness they are counted by {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Set beside {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all the nations amount to nothing; \q to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} they count for less than nothing, for an empty void.
en.R: Compared with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all the nations are nothing. \q He thinks of them as less than nothing, as empty and worthless.

es.L: Todas las naciones [son] como nada delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q como menos que nada y vacío son tenidas por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Comparadas con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, todas las naciones no son nada; \q para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} valen menos que nada, son puro vacío.
es.R: Comparadas con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, todas las naciones no son nada. \q Él las considera menos que nada, vacías y sin valor.

fr.L: Toutes les nations [sont] comme rien devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q moins que le néant et le vide, elles sont comptées par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Placées à côté de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, toutes les nations ne sont rien ; \q pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, elles valent moins que rien, un vide sans forme.
fr.R: Comparées à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, toutes les nations ne sont rien. \q Il les considère comme moins que rien, comme du vide sans valeur.

sw.L: Mataifa yote [ni] kama si kitu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q kama duni kuliko si kitu na utupu yanahesabiwa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.
sw.B: Yakilinganishwa {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, mataifa yote si kitu; \q {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} yanahesabiwa kuwa duni kuliko si kitu, kuwa utupu mtupu.
sw.R: Ukilinganisha na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, mataifa yote si kitu. \q Anayaona kuwa duni kuliko si kitu, kuwa matupu yasiyo na thamani.

vi.L: Mọi dân tộc [đều] như không có gì trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kể chúng như ít hơn không và hư vô.
vi.B: Đặt cạnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mọi dân tộc chẳng là gì cả; \q đối với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng còn kém hơn hư không, chỉ là khoảng trống rỗng.
vi.R: So với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mọi dân tộc chẳng là gì. \q Ngài xem chúng còn kém hơn hư không, trống rỗng và vô giá trị.

decisions.choice: less than nothing
decisions.reason: The preposition can compare ("less than nothing") or describe what they are made of ("of nothing"); the sense is the same: the nations are of no weight beside God.

decisions.choice: emptiness: the formless void before creation
decisions.reason: The word describes the earth before God shaped it (Genesis 1:2) and returns in 40:23 and 41:29.

source.text: וְאֶל־מִ֖י תְּדַמְּי֣וּן אֵ֑ל וּמַה־דְּמ֖וּת תַּ֥עַרְכוּ לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And to whom will you liken God, and what likeness will you compare to him?

en.L: And to whom will you liken God, \q and what likeness will you set beside {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.B: Who, then, will you say God is like? \q What figure could you line up beside {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.R: So who can you compare to God? \q What could you say looks like {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?

es.L: ¿A quién, pues, {{plural_you:compararán|compararéis}} a Dios, \q y qué semejanza {{plural_you:pondrán|pondréis}} junto a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}?
es.B: ¿A quién, entonces, {{plural_you:dirán|diréis}} que se parece Dios? \q ¿Qué figura {{plural_you:podrían|podríais}} poner a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lado?
es.R: ¿Con quién {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} comparar a Dios? \q ¿Qué {{plural_you:podrían|podríais}} decir que se parece a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}?

fr.L: Et à qui comparerez-vous Dieu, \q et quelle ressemblance mettrez-vous à côté de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ?
fr.B: À qui donc direz-vous que Dieu ressemble ? \q Quelle image pourriez-vous placer à côté de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ?
fr.R: Alors, à qui pouvez-vous comparer Dieu ? \q Qu’est-ce qui pourrait {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ressembler ?

sw.L: Basi mtamfananisha Mungu na nani, \q na ni mfano gani mtakaouweka kando {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?
sw.B: Basi mtasema Mungu anafanana na nani? \q Ni sura gani mngeweza kuiweka kando {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?
sw.R: Basi mnaweza kumlinganisha Mungu na nani? \q Ni kitu gani mngeweza kusema kinafanana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}?

vi.L: Vậy các ngươi sẽ ví Đức Chúa Trời với ai, \q và sẽ lấy hình ảnh nào mà so sánh với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.B: Vậy các ngươi sẽ nói Đức Chúa Trời giống ai? \q Các ngươi có thể đặt hình tượng nào bên cạnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.R: Vậy các ngươi có thể so sánh Đức Chúa Trời với ai? \q Các ngươi có thể nói điều gì trông giống {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?

decisions.choice: no likeness can be set beside God
decisions.reason: The question prepares for the idol-makers of verses 19-20, and recalls the command against making images of God (Exodus 20:4; Deuteronomy 4:15-18). It returns in verse 25 and 46:5.

decisions.choice: God: the short divine title El
decisions.reason: The title stresses God's power and stands in contrast with the made objects that follow.

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" to the hearers of verses 18-31
decisions.reason: The questions of verses 18-26 lead up to God's own question in verse 25 and are spoken in his name; Vietnamese keeps one form, "các ngươi", through the passage.

source.text: הַפֶּ֨סֶל֙ נָסַ֣ךְ חָרָ֔שׁ וְצֹרֵ֖ף בַּזָּהָ֣ב יְרַקְּעֶ֑נּוּ וּרְתֻק֥וֹת כֶּ֖סֶף צוֹרֵֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: The idol, a craftsman has cast [it], and a smith with gold overlays it, and chains of silver [he is] refining.

en.L: The idol? A craftsman cast [it], \q and a smith overlays it with gold, \q and he is refining chains of silver.
en.B: An idol? A craftsman casts it, \q a goldsmith plates it in gold \q and refines silver for its chains.
en.R: An idol is made by a worker who pours metal into a mold. \q Then a goldsmith covers it with gold \q and makes silver chains for it.

es.L: ¿El ídolo? Un artesano [lo] funde, \q y el orfebre lo recubre de oro, \q y le funde cadenas de plata.
es.B: ¿Un ídolo? Un artesano lo funde, \q un orfebre lo enchapa de oro \q y le refina cadenas de plata.
es.R: Un ídolo lo hace un obrero que vierte metal en un molde. \q Luego un orfebre lo cubre de oro \q y le hace cadenas de plata.

fr.L: L’idole ? Un artisan [l’]a coulée, \q et un orfèvre la recouvre d’or, \q et il fond des chaînettes d’argent.
fr.B: Une idole ? Un artisan la coule, \q un orfèvre la plaque d’or \q et fond de l’argent pour ses chaînettes.
fr.R: Une idole est faite par un ouvrier qui verse du métal dans un moule. \q Puis un orfèvre la recouvre d’or \q et lui fait des chaînettes d’argent.

sw.L: Sanamu? Fundi aliisubu, \q na mfua dhahabu anaifunika kwa dhahabu, \q naye anasafisha minyororo ya fedha.
sw.B: Sanamu? Fundi huisubu, \q mfua dhahabu huipaka dhahabu \q na kusafisha fedha kwa ajili ya minyororo yake.
sw.R: Sanamu hutengenezwa na fundi anayemimina chuma katika kalibu. \q Kisha mfua dhahabu huifunika kwa dhahabu \q na kuitengenezea minyororo ya fedha.

vi.L: Hình tượng ư? Một người thợ đã đúc [nó], \q và một thợ vàng bọc nó bằng vàng, \q và đang luyện những sợi xích bằng bạc.
vi.B: Một hình tượng ư? Thợ đúc đổ khuôn nó, \q thợ vàng dát vàng cho nó \q và luyện bạc làm dây xích cho nó.
vi.R: Hình tượng do một người thợ đổ kim loại vào khuôn mà làm ra. \q Rồi thợ vàng bọc vàng bên ngoài \q và làm những sợi xích bằng bạc cho nó.

decisions.choice: an idol: a figure of a god made of cast metal and covered with gold
decisions.reason: Idols were often cast in metal or carved in wood and plated with gold and silver (30:22; 44:9-20; Jeremiah 10:3-9).

decisions.choice: chains: silver chains, perhaps to decorate the idol or to fasten it in place
decisions.reason: The word is used only here. Verse 20 and 41:7 suggest the idol had to be fastened so it would not topple.

decisions.choice: pours metal into a mold
decisions.reason: Readable explains the verb "cast".

source.text: הַֽמְסֻכָּ֣ן תְּרוּמָ֔ה עֵ֥ץ לֹֽא־יִרְקַ֖ב יִבְחָ֑ר חָרָ֤שׁ חָכָם֙ יְבַקֶּשׁ־ל֔וֹ לְהָכִ֥ין פֶּ֖סֶל לֹ֥א יִמּֽוֹט׃

records.literal_gloss: The impoverished [one], [as] a contribution, wood [that] will not rot he chooses; a craftsman skillful he seeks for himself to set up an idol [that] will not be shaken.

en.L: The one [too] poor [for such] a contribution \q chooses wood [that] will not rot; \q he seeks for himself a skilled craftsman \q to set up an idol [that] will not totter.
en.B: The one who cannot afford so rich an offering \q chooses a block of wood that will not decay \q and goes looking for a skilled carver \q to mount an idol that will not tip over.
en.R: A person who is too poor to give gold chooses wood that will not rot. \q Then he finds a skilled worker to make an idol that will not fall over.

es.L: El [demasiado] pobre [para tal] ofrenda \q escoge madera [que] no se pudra; \q se busca un artesano hábil \q para erigir un ídolo [que] no se tambalee.
es.B: El que no puede pagar una ofrenda tan rica \q escoge un tronco que no se pudra \q y busca un tallador hábil \q que le monte un ídolo que no se vuelque.
es.R: Una persona demasiado pobre para dar oro escoge una madera que no se pudra. \q Luego busca a un obrero hábil para que le haga un ídolo que no se caiga.

fr.L: Celui qui est [trop] pauvre [pour une telle] offrande \q choisit un bois [qui] ne pourrit pas ; \q il se cherche un artisan habile \q pour dresser une idole [qui] ne vacille pas.
